name: Modular 3D-printed planetary gearbox for NEMA17 (RomanHujer 'Modular planetary gearbox 1024:1'), stackable 4:1 stages

sources.what: product page with hardware list (Thingiverse license field: GPL-3.0)

overallDimsMm.note: 41x41 square housing measured from FCStd body shapes; height depends on stage count (one body I = 19mm, each body II stage = 10.5mm); z not stated for a full 1024:1 stack, so left 0

parts.name: body I (motor-side housing with 27T ring)
parts.notes: measured from FCStd shape 'Tělo I'; bolts to NEMA17 face

parts.name: sun gear I (motor pinion, 9T m1.2)
parts.notes: fits 5mm NEMA17 shaft; measured 'SUN I Final'

parts.name: planet gear 9T m1.2
parts.notes: 3 per stage; FCGear params teeth=9, module=1.2, PA 20deg

parts.name: carrier with integrated next-stage sun
parts.notes: 'Unasec + Sun' = carrier (unášeč) fused with 9T sun of next stage; one per stage

parts.name: carrier lower plate
parts.notes: 'Unasec spodek final'; carrier halves joined with M2 screws

parts.name: top/output gear
parts.notes: STL top_gear_v1; FCStd also contains a helical 10T/29T m1.3 pair (output stage, unconfirmed)

hardware.notes: Thingiverse list; FCStd models M2x4/M2x6 ISO2009 screws on the carriers
tie-rods through the stacked housings into the NEMA17 face

joins.notes: M3x80 threaded rods + M3 nuts clamp the housing stack to the motor's M3 holes
same 4 tie-rods pass through every stacked housing
2x6 self-tapping screws double as planet axles (inferred from 15 screws ~ 3 per stage x 5 stages)

motion.travel: continuous; planets orbit inside fixed 27T ring

assembly.stepsSource: no written guide; author points to a YouTube video
order: press sun I onto NEMA17 shaft
body I with 3 planets on carrier
repeat body II + carrier/sun per extra 4:1 stage
4x M3x80 tie rods + nuts through stack into motor

referenceCad.format: FreeCAD FCStd (BREP shapes read via OCP)

keyDims.note: FCStd is a design workspace, not a placed assembly: 35 visible leaf shapes (1 solid each) all at local origin across 5 design variants; NOT a per-build part count
keyDims.gearParams: sun 9T, planet 9T, ring 27T, module 1.2, PA 20deg, clearance 0.25 (FCGear object properties)

confidence: medium — gear teeth/module and housing dims read directly from the FreeCAD file; hardware list verbatim from Thingiverse; part roles inferred from Czech labels (Tělo=body, unášeč=carrier); per-stage part split and joins partly inferred; no written assembly guide
notes: Picked over the Galileo Clockwork planetary (GPL-3.0, STEP) to avoid overlapping the Voron CW2 entry. Hardware list appears to be for the full 1024:1 stack; per-stage quantities not given.
